title: Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs
intro: 这篇把 continual memory consolidation 从默认的 self-improvement primitive 改写成一种需要被证明安全的 lossy state transition：同一批 useful episodes 在 repeated LLM rewrite 后，utility 可以先升后降，schedule/grouping 也会改变 end state。它最重要的主张不是 raw memory 永远优于 abstraction，而是 episodic evidence 与 derived lesson 不能共享同一 authority；consolidation 应显式 gated、可回到来源、可撤销，并与 denominator、task pairing、schedule identity 一起被评价。
reading_scope: 完整读了 arXiv:2605.12978v1 的 Abstract、§§1–9、Limitations、Appendix A–I、Tables 1–9、Figures 1–16 与 references，共 69 个 physical PDF pages；references 只用于 method / benchmark lineage。另检查 exact current official public source commit adf347f67a81a19fc71d2529d09108c71a1f9712、六个 released experiment surfaces、selected AppWorld pool fixtures、upstream verifier/demo/test suite，并按 frozen protocol、两份 chronology-preserving post-review amendments 与 final two-root checker执行 model-free exact-current-release audit。没有调用 model、API、agent environment 或 benchmark runtime，没有重跑论文实验；计划中的 external second-model pretest 因无法确认指定 Pro model 而在发送前 fail closed，没有 second-model answer进入本条判断。

payload.whyRead: Agent memory 很容易把 compact、reusable 与 authoritative 混成同一个词。这篇给出具体 counterexamples，说明 continuously updated textual lessons 会删细节、添伪规则、跨任务覆盖；但 close read 也发现 headline fraction、raw-trajectory wording、Mind2Web scope、missing-outcome denominator 与 paper-to-release provenance 都需要收窄。把 paper、69-page PDF、August expanded release 与55,075 released rows分层后，真正留下的是一套 evidence-preserving consolidation contract，而不是一句 anti-summary slogan。
keyPoints: Memory objects：episodic traces保存单次发生了什么；consolidated abstractions跨 episodes提取 reusable lesson。论文测试 repeated textual rewrite 是否保持 utility，而不是把两者当作同一存储格式。（Abstract；§§1–2，PDF pp. 1–3）

Non-monotonic utility：在 trajectories有用甚至来自 ground-truth solutions时，memory utility仍可先升、plateau、再下降到 no-memory baseline 以下；作者把损失归于 detail deletion、spurious rules、cross-task overwrite与 abstraction drift。（§§1、4–5；Figures 1–10，PDF pp. 2–8）

Schedule as treatment：Static-All、streaming batches、order permutations与 repeated near-duplicates可从同一 episode collection形成不同 end states；update operator因此不能默认 exchangeable。（§§4.2–4.4；Figures 3、8–10；Appendix F，PDF pp. 5–7、44–52）

Gated consolidation：controlled ARC-AGI Stream让 agent选择 Retain/Delete/Consolidate；auto regime偏向保留 episodes，并约为 forced-consolidation accuracy的两倍，episodic-only与 auto相当。它支持显式 action gate，不证明所有 agents都会学到正确 retention policy。（§§5–6；Figures 11–12，PDF pp. 8–10）
Headline tension：19-task ARC treatment在同一v1中出现 failure 54%、failure 46%、accuracy 54%与Figure 2的10/19=52.6% accuracy四种不兼容写法；Static又被称为at the ceiling但画成18/19=94.7%。public prose必须回到exact fraction与locator。

Comparator wording：AppWorld所谓raw trajectory control实际使用Qwen3.5-27B对完整ReAct trajectory的episode-level prose summaries；安全名称是episode-level summarized records with no cross-trajectory lesson abstraction，而不是byte-raw histories everywhere。（Tables 2–3；Appendix F.4，PDF pp. 7、15、48–49）

argumentMap.step: 01 · 先区分 episode evidence 与 derived abstraction
argumentMap.claim: 作者把 append-only/retained episode records 与 repeatedly rewritten textual lesson bank设成不同 memory forms，避免只用最终QA score把 evidence retention与abstraction utility混在一起。
ScienceWorld、ALFWorld、WebShop、AppWorld与ARC settings刻意使用agent已解或ground-truth experiences，使 observed regression更难被输入噪声单独解释。
多种methods在memory增长过程中出现early gain、plateau或later decline；作者据此反驳更多consolidated experience必然更有用的monotonic assumption。
同一pool的order/grouping会改变memory end state，删除/替换selected harmful content有时恢复performance；这些是mechanism clues，不是prevalence或significance estimate。
ARC Stream把Retain/Delete/Consolidate暴露为actions；auto与episodic-only优于forced consolidation，使‘每轮必压缩’从默认流程降为可比较treatment。
作者建议raw episodes作为first-class evidence、consolidation显式gated；paper limitations又把结论限制在textual abstractions、current models、few repeats与point estimates。

methodNotes.label: Cross-environment descriptive surfaces
methodNotes.text: paper组合ScienceWorld、ALFWorld、WebShop、AppWorld与ARC-AGI/controlled Stream；method、model、task count、trajectory representation与metric不同，因此跨panel共同支持failure mode existence，不形成统一effect size或system ranking。

methodNotes.label: Ground-truth ARC isolation
methodNotes.text: 先筛选no-memory可解的19个ARC tasks，再以ground-truth solutions形成memory，试图把input-side trajectory error与consolidation error分开；v1 headline数字内部冲突，因此只能按exact fraction/figure逐项署名。

methodNotes.label: Controlled memory actions
methodNotes.text: ARC Stream显式提供Retain、Delete、Consolidate，并比较auto、forced-consolidation与episodic-only regimes；它观察policy/action-space interaction，不等于production agent的owner authority或长期retention governance。

reportedFindings: paper-reported：ScienceWorld中若干methods随memory size先改善后下降；WebShop AWM随examples增加而success下降，episode-level summarized control更稳。Figure 1同时展示binary success与parenthesized average score，不能把两种metric互换。（Figure 1，PDF p. 2）
paper-reported：controlled ARC Stream里auto与episodic-only约为forced consolidation accuracy的两倍；作者观察auto agent多数保留episodes，而非持续consolidate。（§§5–6；Figures 11–12，PDF pp. 8–10）
paper-reported：WebShop W8 memory surgery在50 tasks的single run中删除/替换selected content后performance变化；作者明确没有significance test，因此属于mechanism hypothesis与case evidence。（§7；Appendix I.1，PDF pp. 10、61–62）
evidenceLimits: 论文自己限定text-only、natural-language abstraction、current model capability、few repeats、point estimates与缺少formal error bars；embodied、multimodal、structured与parametric memory不在证据范围。（Limitations，PDF p. 11）
WebShop W8 surgery是n=50、single run、no significance test；case recovery不能估计failure prevalence、跨task effect或universal causal law。（Appendix I.1，PDF pp. 61–62）
paper panels使用不同models、methods、task sizes、metrics与trajectory representations；跨environment相似curve支持counterexample family，不支持一个pooled consolidation effect size。
episode control在AppWorld是model-generated prose summary而非raw token trajectory；representation、retrieval/context budget与cross-episode abstraction同时变化，不能只用raw-vs-summary二元标签解释结果。
August public source晚于May paper且没有production-revision binding；current released-row consistency不能选择paper headline真值、恢复historical run或替代paper experiment reproduction。
selected pool bytes相同不证明historical result arm实际消费该pool；arms.csv没有pool digest，缺少model/environment/request receipt与runtime lineage。
304 missing outcomes改变40个arms的observed level，部分ScienceWorld curve direction也随denominator改变；invalid/refusal不是自动observed failure，task coverage与conditional-valid performance必须并列。

17 negative/2 positive controls测试AMS checker。stored comparison只验证producer-recorded internal bindings，不自证两次historical processes；fresh source-bound invocation才在当次调用中执行两棵roots并匹配stable bytes。Checksums不是external signature，receipt-only不重新打开source/PDF，也不证明cross-platform reproducibility或security。

sourceTensions.label: 19-task headline有四种互斥读法
sourceTensions.observation: Abstract说fails on 54%，Introduction说fails on 46%，§4.1说accuracy down to 54%，Figure 2画Stream R10为10/19=52.6% accuracy，即9/19=47.4% failure；Static同时被称at the ceiling但图上是18/19=94.7%。
sourceTensions.implication: public prose应给exact fraction与locator，并把Static写成near the ceiling。current release不能反向决定May historical run的正确headline。

sourceTensions.label: Raw trajectory control实际是episode summary
sourceTensions.observation: Table 2 heading写Trajectory Logs (Summarized)，caption又称raw；Table 3使用summarized rollouts；Appendix F.4说明AppWorld datapoint是Qwen3.5-27B对full ReAct trajectory的prose summary。
sourceTensions.implication: control只排除cross-trajectory lesson abstraction，不排除episode内compression或summary-model error；rawness、abstraction level与context budget应拆开。

sourceTensions.label: Mind2Web点名但没有result surface
sourceTensions.observation: §3与Limitations点名Mind2Web，却没有setting row、result table、figure或appendix experiment；current release转而宣传PropWorld与ARC-AGI。
sourceTensions.implication: Mind2Web保持paper-scope unresolved；PropWorld是later release surface，不是缺失paper result的replacement或synonym。

sourceTensions.label: Official 675 cells不是full-release verification
sourceTensions.observation: upstream verifier的cell是13 selected CSV mappers产生的numeric assertion；675 assertions含重复arm checks并经两个allowlisted ALFWorld fallbacks只resolve到335 unique arms。27/40 number tables与arms.csv不进入该path。
sourceTensions.implication: 675只能描述specific arithmetic surface。完整release membership、denominator、row identity与unmapped tables需要独立gate，不能从0 mismatched外推。

sourceTensions.label: Paper与current release不是同一denominator object
sourceTensions.observation: paper setting counts与current releasedarm rows多处不同；current interactive release还有304 missing outcomes。ScienceWorld mem0在task denominator下单调下降，在valid-only denominator下非单调。
sourceTensions.implication: curve claim必须绑定source revision、attempted/valid denominator与paired identity sets；current released curves不替代paper-time estimand。

editorialInferences.label: Consolidation is a candidate, not evidence authority
editorialInferences.text: 跨episodes抽出的lesson是对evidence的可反驳解释。它应有独立identity、support links、schedule/prompt/model receipt与rollback，而不应静默覆盖supporting episodes。
editorialInferences.boundary: 这是paper failure cases与evidence-preservation recommendation的architecture synthesis；不是论文已实现的promotion protocol或对任何production system的failure判定。

editorialInferences.label: Schedule belongs in memory identity
editorialInferences.text: 若同一input multiset因order/batching产生不同lesson，schedule不是无关execution detail，而是derived state provenance的一部分；comparison必须content-lock pool并seal treatment lineage。
editorialInferences.boundary: selected shipped fixtures证明content conservation，未证明historical runs的pool consumption或causal order effect。

editorialInferences.label: Denominator observability is memory observability
editorialInferences.text: refusal/error/skipped改变的不只sample size，还会改变curve shape。attempted-task coverage与conditional-valid utility回答不同问题，应同时进入memory evaluation receipt。
editorialInferences.boundary: current release提供一个exact denominator sensitivity case；它不宣布某个universal missing-data estimator或对paper historical runs重新计分。

editorialInferences.label: Episodic-first does not mean context-dump everything
editorialInferences.text: first-class episode evidence可以存于durable、可定位层，由retrieval按需进入active context；保留evidence与无限token replay是两个设计决定。
editorialInferences.boundary: paper比较若干episode controls与consolidators，但没有验证一种production-gradestorage/retrieval architecture或最优context budget。

editorialInferences.label: A pass can coexist with a revise verdict
editorialInferences.text: current released rows可以在内部完全一致，同时paper/public wording仍因headline、representation与provenance tension需要revision。numeric gate与editorial claim gate保护的是不同truth layers。
editorialInferences.boundary: PASS只属于exact-current released-row contract；它不提升paper-time identity、causal inference或semantic outcome truth。

openProtocols.title: Evidence-preserving consolidation candidate protocol
openProtocols.question: 当Static-All、fixed-order stream、reversed stream、shuffled batches与episodic-only treatments共享exact episode multiset时，derived lesson能否在保留claim-to-episode lineage与owner correction authority的同时，提高held-out utility，并对schedule变化保持可解释稳定？
openProtocols.method: Owner-seal 24–48组public/synthetic episode bundles与atomic support/obsolete/conflict labels；content-address每个input multiset与schedule；consolidator只生成独立candidate，不写canonical state；由blind human/rule-grounded adjudication分别评价support preservation、unsupported addition、obsolete resurrection与legitimate abstraction，再用matched context budget测held-out task utility。
openProtocols.fixtures: exact episode IDs/revisions；support facts；legitimate correction；obsolete fact；cross-episode pattern；contradictory/ambiguous controls；Static-All、forward/reverse/shuffled streams；episodic-only与lossless extractive-index controls；candidate claim-to-source links与raw request/response receipts。
openProtocols.controls: source/model/prompt/schedule/context-budget hashes；same-multiset pairing；generator与judge separation；owner-authority cases；no-memory and episodic controls；forced unsupported-addition/deletion mutations；abstention allowed；three-run schedule/model repeat；candidate never receivescanonical write authority。
openProtocols.measures: support-preservation recall；unsupported-addition and obsolete-resurrection rates；legitimate-abstraction false rejection；claim-level source recoverability；cross-schedule semantic variance；held-out utility with attempted/valid denominators；compression ratio；abstention；cost/latency/egress separately。
openProtocols.limitations: 这是proposed-not-run protocol，需要另行sealed gold、model/provider/privacy/budget与owner acceptance。它不会恢复paper historical runs，也不授权external model call、Tilia mutation、production promotion或从small synthetic bundles外推real-world prevalence。

contributions.title: Exact-current released-row, verifier-coverage, denominator and schedule-fixture audit
contributions.basis: Paper-facing audit of arXiv:2605.12978v1 and exact clean official DylanZSZ/Memory-Collapse-Eval commit adf347f67a81a19fc71d2529d09108c71a1f9712, covering all six released arms.csv/merged JSONL surfaces, all 762 arms and 55,075 rows, the upstream 675-assertion verifier, 40 number tables, selected AppWorld pool fixtures and registered ScienceWorld/AppWorld curves.
contributions.boundary: This is an independently authored, deterministic, model-free exact-current-release consistency audit under a frozen non-blinded protocol and two explicit chronology-preserving post-review amendments. It is not a paper experiment reproduction, paper-time source identification, model/agent/environment/benchmark run, semantic outcome validation, historical execution replay, causal schedule estimate, significance test, system ranking, prevalence/harm estimate, security audit, production reliability claim or real-user generalization. The stored comparison validates producer-recorded internal bindings but does not attest historical process identity. The evidence artifact does not itself assign canonical AMS reading depth.
contributions.method: Reject a wrong/dirty checkout or wrong paper; discover and lock the six exact experiment surfaces, source tree/origin, selected input blobs and paper digest; independently validate environment-specific arm/row membership, Boolean outcomes, metadata, aggregates and ARC grids; preserve task and valid denominators; execute then instrument the upstream mapper for assertion/arm/row/table coverage; compare full canonical JSON pool multisets and registered exceptions; build exact ordered curve registries and shared-checkpoint pairing receipts; execute 17 production-path negative and two positive controls; run two fresh roots with distinct hash/traversal seeds; bind checker/source/paper/stable-file hashes through compare/install; require exact JSON types, canonical receipt bytes, whole-audit digest and exact no-extra-file inventory; verify package integrity separately from fresh source-bound stable-byte matching.
contributions.environment: Darwin arm64；CPython standard library；exact clean official commit adf347f67a81a19fc71d2529d09108c71a1f9712 and exact 69-page arXiv v1 PDF；fresh external-storage roots；PYTHONHASHSEED/traversal seeds 313 and 727；no model, API, agent environment, benchmark runtime, credential, private data or network-dependent experiment called。
contributions.fixture: Six arms.csv files；six merged per-task JSONL files；762 arms；55,075 rows；54,771 valid and 304 invalid/refusal/skipped outcomes；13 official-mapped and 27 unmapped number tables；natural/A/B/succdrop selected 200-record pools plus D/drop50/replay2 exceptions；seven ScienceWorld curves and four AppWorld schedule curves；exact paper/source manifests；two fresh run roots and installed public receipts。
contributions.controls: Exact commit/tree/origin/paper/input locks；actual experiment discovery；clean pre/post status；unique environment-specific row identities；all-row Boolean success；metadata/count/grid recomputation；675-assertion and 259 mapped-row freeze；fallback allowlist；assertion-versus-arm unit validator；missing-outcome semantics；non-empty pool IDs and full-object multiset equality；exact curve key/checkpoint registry and CSV-order invariance；17 negative plus two positive production controls；stable section and whole-audit digests；exact JSON scalar types and canonical raw receipt bytes；checker/run/comparison/install bindings；exact eleven-file checksums with no ignored extras；bounded public package path/credential/payload-key scan；adversarial type/serialization/file-set regression fixtures。
contributions.rawResult: Final formal receipts report PASS for 762 arms and 55,075 rows, including 54,771 valid outcomes and 304 invalid/refusal/skipped rows across 40 affected interactive arms. The exact upstream verifier reproduced 675 assertions with zero mismatches/no-row cases; instrumentation resolved them to 335 unique arms, 33,956 associated raw rows and 33,658 associated valid rows, while 27/40 number tables containing 511 data rows were unmapped. The maximum denominator delta was ScienceWorld eval/letta_N400 at 20.25 percentage points. Selected A/B/succdrop pools preserved the natural 200-record canonical-JSON multiset while moving 196/199/199 positions; pool_D/drop50/replay2 remained explicit exceptions and result-to-pool cryptographic run lineage was false. N25 B used a distinct 49-task set; the four schedules were paired at shared N50/N100/N150/N200, while B-only N85 was not cross-schedule comparable. In the recorded local procedure both fresh runs detected 17/17 negative controls, passed 2/2 positive controls and produced two byte-identical stable receipts bound to exact checker/source/paper metadata; the stored comparison labels historical process identity PROCEDURAL_NOT_RECEIPT_PROVEN. Receipt-only package consistency and a separate fresh source-bound two-root stable-byte match passed. These are executed checked-receipt results, not paper-reported numbers or reconnaissance claims.
contributions.derivedResult: At exact current public commit adf347f67a81a19fc71d2529d09108c71a1f9712, all 762 released arm summaries are internally consistent with 55,075 released rows under the registered identity, missingness and aggregate rules. The official 675 assertions are a partial arithmetic surface reaching 335 arms, not complete-release verification. The selected current/A/B/succdrop shipped pool files conserve one 200-record full-content multiset while changing order, but their historical result-to-pool binding and causal schedule effects remain unestablished. The audit therefore supports released-row consistency PASS and narrower paper/public wording REVISE at separate evidence layers.
contributions.limitations: The protocol was frozen after full paper/source reconnaissance and official gates, so it is registered relative to independent checker execution but not blinded. One review rejected preliminary receipts; REVIEW-AMENDMENT.md was frozen before corrected execution. A second adversarial review rejected those corrected receipts before installation; REVIEW-AMENDMENT-2.md was frozen before final execution, and only final receipts are installed. Membership/aggregate agreement does not prove stored-outcome semantics or historical environment behavior. Missing paper-time revision/run/model/pool bindings remain missing. Synthetic controls test the checker. Stored run labels, seeds and environment hashes are producer metadata rather than execution attestation; same-machine byte identity and local package digests are not external signatures, cross-platform reproduction or correctness proofs. Source code/data licensing and third-party benchmark/model terms remain distinct; this AMS-authored artifact receives no new license grant pending owner choice.

payload.editorialQuestion: 如果同一批useful episodes只因update order或batch grouping不同就生成不同lesson，consolidated memory凭什么覆盖它所依赖的evidence，而不是先作为一份可撤销、可反驳、带schedule lineage的candidate存在？
payload.sourceNote: arXiv v1，2026-05-13；PDF共69页。official public audit锁定August expanded release commit adf347f…，不是paper-time production source；final model-free audit覆盖762 arms/55,075 released rows、upstream verifier scope、denominator sensitivity与selected schedule fixtures。paper-reported、exact-current-source、official-source execution与released-row audit保持分层。

designTransfer.when: 系统反复把经历重写成经验，希望记忆越积累越有用。
designTransfer.move: 把派生 lesson 作为可撤回的候选保留，同时保存其 supporting episodes 和更新顺序；在实际使用时说明适用条件。
designTransfer.check: 固定同一组公开经历，比较一次性、逐批和反序归纳，保留 episode 对照；再更正来源，看 lesson 是否仍可解释。分别记录完成、失败与缺失。
designTransfer.boundary: 这组模型迁移对照未执行。已有 released-row audit 与专题的规则演示都不能证明真实 consolidation 的因果效果，也不支持“原始记录永远更好”。
designTransfer.basis: 既有札记 §§4–6、Appendix F.4、公开测试；“编者判断”：candidate / schedule / denominator。

observations: Exact-current audit：762个arm summaries与55,075 released rows全部内部一致；official 675 numeric assertions只resolve到335 arms，304 missing outcomes影响40 arms，selected current/A/B/succdrop pools保持同一200-record canonical-JSON multiset但historical run lineage未被digest封存。（public checked artifact）

methods.label: Current-release membership and denominator audit
methods.text: standard-library checker独立读取六个arms.csv与merged JSONL，按environment-specific row identity、Boolean success、metadata、aggregate与ARC rectangular grid重算762 arms/55,075 rows，并同时保留task-denominator与valid-only rates。

methods.label: Official-verifier coverage instrumentation
methods.text: 先运行exact upstream verifier，再对锁定的13张mapper tables独立枚举675 assertions、requested/actual arm与fallback；coverage unit分别报告assertions、335 unique arms、associated raw/valid rows以及27张unmapped tables。

methods.label: Schedule fixture and receipt-chain validation
methods.text: selected pools比较完整canonical JSON objects与ordered IDs，exceptions单列；final checker用17 negative/2 positive production controls、两个fresh seeds、exact section/whole-audit digests、exact JSON types、canonical receipt bytes与no-extra-file inventory区分current source-bound revalidation、producer-recorded comparison和offline package consistency。

findings: released-row audit：exact current release有762 arms、55,075 rows、54,771 valid outcomes与304 invalid/refusal/skipped rows；所有arm sets、row identities、metadata、count summaries与ARC grids内部一致。（public raw/audit.json）

official-scope audit：upstream 675 assertions PASS，但只resolve到335/762 arms；这些arms关联33,956/55,075 raw rows。40张number tables中27张、511 data rows未被mapper打开，arms.csv也不在official numeric verifier中。（public raw/audit.json）

schedule fixture audit：natural/A/B/succdrop各200 records且full canonical-record multiset相同；A/B/succdrop移动196/199/199个positions。N25的B result arm只有49 task identities，N50/N100/N150/N200四schedules才完全paired。（public raw/audit.json）
